result.summary: Found 3 issues: a critical data display error, a major content truncation problem, and a major naming truncation issue.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee amount
issues.suggestion: Debug the delivery fee data source and ensure valid numeric values are returned. Replace NaN with actual fee or appropriate fallback message.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally cut off, obscuring part of the card content
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel/grid layout to ensure all cards are fully visible, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible scroll indicators.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated and incomplete
issues.suggestion: Display the full restaurant name or implement text truncation with ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccolo...') to indicate continuation.

issues.description: Category filter pills on the right side are partially cut off, indicating a horizontal overflow
issues.suggestion: Make category pills horizontally scrollable or reduce padding/size to fit all options in viewport.
